title: Carlin Tunnel proof of concept scan

tellings.quote: So, we here here we have the Carlin Tunnel.

plain: In 2024, the underground scanning method of a researcher named Filippo Biondi was tried on the Carlin Tunnel, a known tunnel, as a test to show it could pick out hidden spaces below the surface. A researcher named Jeffrey Drum shows this scan to Michels ("here we have the Carlin Tunnel") without naming a source. It matters because the same method is behind the claim of a vast structure beneath the pyramids of Egypt.
